Question 1
?

Find the particular solution to the differential equation dydx=−xyln⁡y that satisfies y(0)=e.

a
ln2⁡y=1−2x2
b
 ln2⁡y=(1−x)2
c
ln2⁡y=1−x2
d
 ln2⁡y=2x2+1
e
 ln2⁡y=x2+1
